gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-metrophobic: Bruno Ace draws its letters like a bent paperclip, one ruler-straight line of constant width looping through every shape. Metrophobic is the quiet one, letting the eye glide smoothly around each bend while the heading grabs attention.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-mina: Bruno Ace letters keep their counters linked to the outside, drawn with a ruler-straight line that never changes width. Mina brings thread-plain strokes and generously unclosed small round letters, which hold up nicely at a modest size.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-cypro-mino: Noto Sans Cypro Minoan trims its terminals back to leave a big gap. Noto Sans Cypro Minoan handles the reading, while Bruno Ace takes the showy work, building uppercase from lines of one constant thickness.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Bruno Ace has rope-like consistency in every stem, bowl and tail. Noto Sans Hatran, with a funnel-wide throat in its e, then lets paragraphs unspool easily and approachably without any fuss.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-inscriptio: Rope-like stems carry Bruno Ace through every bowl and tail. Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi feels unclogged by comparison, its small counters easy and approachable, a light touch beside that rope-drawn weight.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Expressive and ruler-straight, Bruno Ace holds a single line weight through every letter. Noto Sans Javanese keeps counters connected to outside space, and that clean openness is the pairing's real draw.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Expressive to the core, Bruno Ace keeps a unit-width stroke throughout. Noto Sans Kawi adds a clean, open-jawed c like a pair of pliers, and the heading would lose its force if made small.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Crisp and ruler-straight, Bruno Ace keeps a single line weight, with no heavy-light flicker catching the eye. Make the heading small and Noto Sans Linear A takes over.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-mongolian: Distinctive and expressive, Bruno Ace stitches its strokes like thread along a path. Noto Sans Mongolian sits beside it with flared terminals and a modern, neutral manner, letting the heading do the talking.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-lu: Bruno Ace has a flat, stencil-cut feel, every stroke a single weight, with counters that stay connected to the outside. Noto Sans New Tai Lue rounds its letters cupped rather than clenched.
